column1: # DCGM exporter counter set - qwen36-27b A100 tuning campaign
# Format: DCGM_FIELD_NAME | prometheus type | help text
# PARSER RULES - dcgm-exporter uses a strict Go CSV reader that counts
# fields on EVERY line including comments. A comment must therefore have
# exactly 3 fields: end each one with a trailing double comma. Never put
# a comma or a double-quote character inside comment text - a comma gives
# a wrong-number-of-fields fatal and a quote gives a bare-quote parse
# error. Either one crash-loops the container. Rationale and the
# nsys/CUPTI conflict warning live in README.md next to this file.
